description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Historical daily weather (temperature, precipitation, wind, sunshine) for any location from 1940 to ~5 days ago. Uses ERA5 reanalysis data. Accepts city name or lat,lng. Returns per-day values plus period summary stats. Useful for seasonal analysis, anomaly detection, and climate-context enrichment.
